lines.en: But this contract was meant to get me fed and give me a way forward. I have the way now.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 再让这一页拖着你，就成了我占便宜。我没那么厚的脸。
lines.en: Keep you tied down with it, and I'd be taking advantage. I'm not that shameless.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 先跟你把几笔账摆开。许可证是你办的，礼服也是你从库里翻出来的。
lines.en: A few things up front. You arranged the pass. You dug the gown out of storage.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 最开头那次我唱砸了，你那一晚没关灯，一直等到我拎着裙摆走到窗口前。
lines.en: The night I first sang and made a mess of it, you left the light on until I came to the window, holding up my skirt.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你把我送到门口，这笔我记下了。
lines.en: You got me to the door. I'll own that.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 可台上那口气，是我自己调上来的。你也得认。
lines.en: But the breath I found on that stage was mine. You have to own that too.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我认。
lines.en: I do.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 成，那我把账算给你听。
lines.en: Good. Then let's settle up.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 工钱就结到今天，多一天少一天都不行。拾荒那栏单独算，别跟工钱搅在一起。
lines.en: Wages through today, not a day more or less. Scavenging gets its own line—don't mix it with wages.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 跟你借的那笔另算。下个月驻场钱一到，我先还一部分，还是照老样子慢慢清。
lines.en: The loan's not included. When next month's residency pay comes in, I'll pay a chunk back, slow as before.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 还有……旧约今天不续了，但我没想躲着不来。
lines.en: And... the old contract's done, but I'm not planning to stop coming.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 接下来按新的来：不唱歌的日子，我照旧来认货、记账。唱的那两晚请假。
lines.en: New terms: on days I don't sing, I still come appraise goods and keep the books. The two nights I sing, I take off.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 工钱按我到店的天数结。拾荒我不一定顾得上，看见好东西还是带回来给你过目。
lines.en: Pay me by the days I show up. I may have less time to scavenge, but if I spot good stuff, I'll bring it for you.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 就这些。哪条你不点头，直接提。
lines.en: That's it. Anything you don't like, say it now.

segments.prompt: 她邀请店主去上层晚会
segments.prompt_en: She invites the shopkeeper to the Upper Level gala

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 她把那张厚请柬按在柜台上，贴着台面推过去，指头仍压住边角。
lines.en: She slides a heavy card invitation across the counter, a fingertip pinning one corner, not letting go.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 这页你看进眼里之前，先别接话。
lines.en: Read first. Don't talk yet.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 晚会请柬。
lines.en: An invitation.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 上层有场晚会，沙龙那位老板摆的，一年只有这一回。
lines.en: An Upper Level gala. The salon owner hosts it himself, once a year.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 他请的是几户有头脸的人家，驻场的也请了，我手里就来了这张。
lines.en: He invites a few families of standing, and the residency performers. I got this one.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 请我去唱两首。请柬上除了我的全名，没加任何别的字。
lines.en: I'm asked to sing two songs. It's printed with my full name. Not one extra word.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 这回连那位老板都多留了心，交到我手上以前，自己先翻来覆去瞧了三回。
lines.en: Even the salon owner learned his lesson this time. He read it three times himself before handing it over.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 往底看。嘉宾位能带一位，这一栏还空着。
lines.en: Look at the line at the bottom. Guest: one permitted. Still blank.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 他送请柬来的时候还笑着，说我想写谁就写谁，写旧相识也随我。
lines.en: The salon owner was smiling when he gave it to me. Said write anyone I like, even an old acquaintance.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我在上头的旧相识，自我母亲出事后，好些都不认得我了。
lines.en: Most of my old acquaintances up there stopped knowing me around the time my mother's trouble started.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 笔给我。
lines.en: Lend me a pen.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 抽出笔放到她手边给。
lines.en: Hands her the pen Here.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 把袖口往上折了一折，笔尖在嘉宾栏边停了一停，写下去，又涂掉，再落笔好了。
lines.en: Writes a line, pauses, then crosses it out and starts again. There.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我的店主。
lines.en: "My shopkeeper."

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 别念出来……我先头只写了“当铺店主”，搁在纸上像给货物登名字。
lines.en: Why read it out loud? ...At first I only wrote "Shopkeeper, pawnshop." It looked like a stock entry.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 剩下两个字，我不落到这张纸上，留着只在嘴边和该叫的人前叫。
lines.en: I'm not putting that other word on paper. That's between you and me.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 别人要问起你，我只会讲这位是我店主，铺子开在下层区。
lines.en: If anyone asks, I'll say he's my shopkeeper. He runs a pawnshop on the Lower Level.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 哪个要笑，我就在他跟前立着，等他笑不动了自己收声。
lines.en: Anyone who laughs, I'll stand beside him and watch him finish. Once he's had his fill, he'll get bored on his own.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你别一开口就说去了不合适。那阵子是你给我跑许可证，现在该我拉着你往上走一程。
lines.en: Don't tell me you don't belong up there. You used to arrange my passes. This time I'll vouch for you.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 衣裳你不用管，旧衣堆里那件深色外套，我收货时给你比过，肩宽对得上。
lines.en: I've picked your clothes too. There's a dark coat in the old-clothes pile. I measured it when I appraised it. The shoulders fit you.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 这事让我母亲听见了，她旁的没问，就问你脚上有没有一双能出门的鞋。
lines.en: My mother heard. She asked nothing else, only whether you own a decent pair of shoes.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我照实说没有。她讲那你就挺直背，没人会往鞋上低眼。
lines.en: I said no. She said then have you stand up straight. Nobody looks down at shoes.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 该说的都在这了。现在告诉我，去，还是不去。
lines.en: That's all. Are you going or not? Give me an answer.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 为什么是我？
lines.en: Why me?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 还问这个？名字挂在我名下，字也是我填的。
lines.en: You need to ask? That line is mine. I wrote the name.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……我若带旁人去，第二首唱着一半，眼神都没处放。话说到这儿，你去不去。
lines.en: ...If I brought anyone else, I wouldn't know where to look during the second song. There. Are you coming or not?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 去。
lines.en: I'll go.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 把请柬拿起来，低头定在嘉宾那一栏上，半天没动
lines.en: Picks up the invitation and stares at that line for a long time

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 还没看够？就四个字，又不是账本，值得看这么久？
lines.en: Finished staring? Two words. It's not a ledger.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 去。
lines.en: I'll go.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……半天就挤出这一个字。行，这个答复我收着。
lines.en: ...All that staring, and you squeeze out two words. Fine. I'll take it.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我去。
lines.en: I'll go.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……你倒不推一下？我来之前想好一肚子话，全没处使了。
lines.en: ...You're not even going to protest? I rehearsed my arguments the whole way here. All wasted.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你写了名字，我就去。
lines.en: You wrote my name. So I'll go.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 到了那天你随便站，只一件，别挑最靠后的墙角缩着。
lines.en: Stand wherever you like that night. Just don't hide all the way in the back.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 头一首我面朝底下的客人唱。第二首，你眼睛不许往别处跑。
lines.en: The first song, I'll sing to the crowd. The second one, don't you dare drift off.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 不走神。
lines.en: I won't.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 唱罢了有人拉着我搭话，我最多应三句就脱身，后面都陪你。
lines.en: If they corner me after, I'll give them three sentences and leave. The rest of the night is yours.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 散场怎么回我也打听清楚了。等散了场，我们一块下来。
lines.en: I've already asked about the way back. When it's over, we come down together.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 她朝巷口偏了偏头，见近处没人，声音压低主人，到了上头我改口叫你店主。你答应一声就好，别笑。
lines.en: Glances down the alley and lowers her voiceMaster, up there I'll call you shopkeeper. Just answer. No laughing.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 不笑。
lines.en: No laughing.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 她把请柬转到他那一侧，压着边角的手指抬开这张你收下。折了角我也不会替你再去讨一张。
lines.en: Lifts the finger pinning the invitationKeep this. If you crease it, I'm not asking for another.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 那盏柜台灯没关。她已经换回女仆装，站在窗户外头，指头搭在柜沿上。
lines.en: The counter lamp is lit. Back in her maid dress, she stands outside the window with her hand on the counter edge.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 回来那身礼服我挂起了，鞋也脱了。脚后跟磨掉一块皮，你别问这个。
lines.en: The gown's back and hung up. I changed my shoes too. Wore a patch of skin off my heel. Don't ask.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 杯子跟客气话都留在楼上了，我一件也没带下来。
lines.en: All those glasses, all those pleasantries up there. I left every one of them upstairs.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 手从窗口外探进来 主人。
lines.en: Reaches toward him through the windowMaster.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 嗯。
lines.en: Mm.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 楼上的人叫了我一整晚埃莉诺小姐。到你嘴里，就一个嗯。
lines.en: Just "mm." I got called Miss Eleanor all night up there, and I come back to one "mm" from you.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 行，我就图这一声。
lines.en: Fine. Of course that's the one I like best.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 有人问起你是谁，我答了句店主。他还没回神，我已经走了。
lines.en: Someone asked who was with me. I said my shopkeeper. He froze, and I walked off before he recovered.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 第二首的时候我往台下看，你那肩膀整晚都没松开过。
lines.en: Your shoulders were tense all night. I saw it during the second song.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 坐下，手递来。今天的活归我，你一样都别碰。
lines.en: Sit down. Give me your hand. I'll do the work today. Don't touch anything.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 靠窗坐下，把一只手放到柜面上 坐好了。
lines.en: Sits inside the window and puts his hand on the counterI'm sitting.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 双手捧住他的手，把蜷紧的指头一点一点揉平 僵成这样。楼上的椅子比我的鞋还难坐？
lines.en: Cups his hand in both of hers and slowly kneads his clenched fingersYour hand's stiff too. Were those chairs upstairs worse than my shoes?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 别这样看。这身裙子店里本来就有，你也不是头回见。
lines.en: Don't just stare. This dress is from the shop. You've seen it before.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……想瞧就瞧吧，巷子里没人。
lines.en: ...Look if you want. There's no one in the alley.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 身子往柜沿边压过去，领口向下坠了一点，指腹从手腕一路揉上去 还要往上？到这儿？
lines.en: Leans over the counter edge, her neckline dipping as her fingers press up his wristA little higher. Here?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 这儿。
lines.en: There.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你还挺会使唤人。 手上加重点
lines.en: You're good at ordering people around. Presses a little harder

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 乏了就开口。我手可以歇，在窗边陪你待着。
lines.en: Tell me if you're tired. I can stop and just keep you company here at the window.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 这些我做得高兴。你不愿意，就直说。
lines.en: I do these things because I want to. If you don't want them, you can say no.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 别停。
lines.en: Don't stop.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 那就接着。
lines.en: Hmph. Then I won't.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 下个月那两晚，我照旧上去唱。唱完还是下来，回这边记账。
lines.en: Those two nights next month, I'll still go up and sing. Then I'll come back down and keep the books here.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 楼上给我留门。我往哪头走，心里有数。
lines.en: The Upper Level left a door open for me. I know which way I'm going.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 还有半首欠着。那支老调，我上回到第三句就收住了。
lines.en: Oh, and I still owe you half a song. That old tune from last time—I only hummed to the third line.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 还记着。
lines.en: I remember.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 就知道你记得。 手搭上他腕子，压下嗓子，从第三句往下接
lines.en: Knew you'd remember.Keeps her hand on his wrist and sings softly from the third line onward

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 唱到最末一句，弯下腰把柜台灯调低一点 半首，还清了。
lines.en: After the last line, she leans over and turns the counter lamp down a notchHalf a song. Paid in full.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 伏在柜沿，掌心盖住他手背，抬眼看他 主人，别的账都等明天再记。
lines.en: Leans on the counter edge, her palm over his hand, and looks up at himMaster, leave the rest of tonight's accounts until tomorrow.
